notes.title: Update 1.10 is now live
notes.content:
Update 1.10 contains the following new features and bug fixes:

[list]
[*]Golem attack speed has been increased;
[*]Golem health has been reduced to compensate for the increase in attack speed;
[*]Rabbits will no longer vanish and re-appear when the day/night cycle is turned of in the options;
[*]Fixed bug where rabbits would not run away from units.
[*]Main Menu now has a static background to reduce loading times;
[*]Improved smoke particles for bakery and artillary foundry.
[*]Puddles will now form when its raining.
[*]Improved snow weather effects.
[*]Chests will now only contain gold, swords, bows or magical staffs.
[*]Mines will now only contain a certain amount of resources.
[*]Mines that are destroyed or run out of resources will now leave behind rubble, making the area unbuildable. This will make the defence of your mines a main priority.
[*]Mines HP has been doubled.
[*]New added features 'Fire' and 'Ice' runes. Fire and ice runes will deal magic damage to any enemy units that pass over them.
[*]The game mode button will no longer be displayed behind the custom settings in the skirmish mode menu.
[*]The AI teams will stop producing a resource if the count is over 200 (except wood and ores). This will stop the AI from mass producing resources that it does not need.
[*]The production speed of resources has been reduced.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02 is now live
notes.content:
Here is a list of all the bug fixes/changes/new features in update 1.02.

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where AI mines were producing resources faster than the players.
[*]Tool tip in the mission select screen will no longer appear below buttons.
[*]Fixed bug where units would not move if mouse was clicked near the bottom of the screen.
[*]Fixed bug where groups were not cleared correctly when selecting the clear button.
[*]Markers are now dropped by clicking the left mouse button instead of the right.
[*]Farms will produce wheat faster when its raining.
[*]Fixed bug where yellow team windmills were not being destroyed.
[*]The AI will now become hostile at a slower or faster rate depending on the difficulty.
[*]The number of player slots will now be shown next to the maps filename in skirmish mode.
[*]Skirmish maps can now be filtered depending on the number of player slots.
[*]General bug fixes.
[/list]

Changes to keys:
W-A-S-D will now move the camera in addition to the arrow keys.
1-2-3-4-5 can now be used to put units into a group.
6-7-8-9-0 will now change the building tabs.
U-I-O-P-H-J-K-L are now used to select the buildings you wish to build.
Space Bar will now pause the game.

notes.title: Update 1.01 is now live
notes.content:
Early Access update 1.01 is now live, the update includes a number of fixes and a new diplomacy feature. The full list can be viewed below:

Early Access 1.01
•	Diplomacy options added.
•	Resources now have tool tips in the resource menu.
•	Fixed bug where iron smelters sound effects could be heard out of camera view.
•	Enemy archers, portable cannons, wizards and cavalry remain stationary while attacking buildings, this will make them more effective against towers.
•	AI teams can now be removed in the skirmish menu.

Diplomacy options quickly explained
•	Players can now team up with or declare war with the AI during the match.
•	Players can request resources from allies.
•	AI allies will request resources from the player, if the player doesn't send the requested resources in the allocated time the ally's favour meter will reduce. If the meter reaches zero the AI will no longer be an ally of the player.
•	If too many of your military units are within your ally’s territory this will make the favour meter fall.
•	The AI will only attack your base if they are hostile towards you (two swords).
•	The AI will only attack your units if you are too close to their military units in half-hostile mode (one sword).
•	The AI will help you defend your base, if they have enough units, in ally mode (dove).
•	If an AI becomes hostile you can make them half-hostile by sending them resources to increase their favour meter.
•	The more resources you give an AI the higher the favour meter will be filled.
•	The AI will only accept becoming an ally if they are half-hostile and their favour meter is high.
•	If the AI already has an ally it will refuse the ally with the player.
•	Requested resources from ally will reduce the favour meter by an equal amount, 10 resource = 10 favour percent.
